theater: 蘇伊士運河與戈蘭高地

battle.name: 第四次中東戰爭
battle.theater: 蘇伊士運河與戈蘭高地
battle.brief: 1973年10月6日，埃及與敘利亞以逾兩千門火炮同時進攻。埃及主力在蘇伊士運河架浮橋渡河，突破巴爾萊夫防線並在西奈建立橋頭堡；敘利亞在戈蘭高地正面進攻。以軍以M60A1巴頓戰車為骨幹的裝甲部隊遲到數日才成建制投入，首日損失慘重，十月中旬渡河反攻才扭轉局勢。

kit.name: M60A1巴頓戰車
kit.history: 1971年以色列自美國接收並列裝的M60A1，1973年配屬西奈與戈蘭方向的裝甲部隊，用於前線火力支援。

countries: 交戰的一方是阿拉伯聯盟陣營。埃及由總統安瓦爾·薩達特主持，陸軍在蘇伊士運河東岸沿運河線展開，最前線是西奈的巴爾萊夫防線，突擊主力為第二、第三裝甲師與第十六、第二十三步兵師，工兵部隊在運河上架設浮橋，後方由塞得港與鐵路輸送補給。敘利亞由總統哈菲茲·阿薩德指揮，在戈蘭高地與以色列對峙，投入第九、第十、第十二步兵師以及第三裝甲師等部，其正面部署密度是全役最高。伊拉克、科威特、利比亞、沙特阿拉伯、摩洛哥、南北也門與阿爾及利亞等國分別派兵、派款或提供後勤，約旦在北部約旦河一線投入有限裝甲兵力，巴勒斯坦解放陣線也組織突擊隊作戰。另一方是以色列：總理果爾達·梅里爾、國防部長摩西·達揚、總參謀長哈伊姆·赫爾佐格組成最高指揮部，部隊分屬常備兵與首批召集的後備軍，裝甲主力為第一四三裝甲師與第一六二裝甲師。阿拉伯方面的裝備體系分屬兩套：埃及、敘利亞與伊拉克主力為蘇制裝備，並混用少量英制與法制舊裝；以色列則是美制、法制與英制混合的後勤體系，本役中美方開闢空運通道緊急補給。
countriesEn: One of the belligerents was the Arab League camp. Egypt was headed by President Anwar Sadat. Its army was deployed along the east bank of the Suez Canal, the forward line being the Bar Lev Line in Sinai, with the second and third armoured divisions and the sixteenth and twenty-third infantry divisions as the main assault force, engineer troops bridging the canal, and the rear supplied through Port Said and the railway. Syria was commanded by President Hafez al-Assad and confronted Israel on the Golan Heights, committing the ninth, tenth and twelfth infantry divisions together with the third armoured division and other formations, its frontage density being the highest in the campaign. Iraq, Kuwait, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, the two Yemens, Sudan and Algeria sent troops, money or logistic support in varying degrees; Jordan committed limited armour on the Jordan river front in the north; and the Palestine Liberation Organisation also mounted commando operations. The other side was Israel: Prime Minister Golda Meir, Defence Minister Moshe Dayan and Chief of Staff Chaim Herzog formed the highest command, and the forces were divided between the standing army and the first mobilisation of the reserves, the armoured strength being the 143rd and 162nd Armoured Divisions. The Arab side ran two equipment systems: Egypt, Syria and Iraq drew mainly on Soviet material, with a small admixture of British and French older types, while Israel ran a mixed American, French and British logistic system, and during this campaign the United States opened an airlift corridor to resupply it urgently.
people: 關鍵人物集中在兩端。安瓦爾·薩達特是攻勢的決策者，他選定贖罪日開火，並事先與哈菲茲·阿薩德商定東西兩線同時進攻，使以色列無法集中兵力和航空兵支援；哈菲茲·阿薩德承擔的是在戈蘭方向正面壓制以色列預備隊的任務，其前線指揮體系同樣未能奪回關鍵山地。果爾達·梅里爾主持動員，批准召集後備軍，這是以色列建國以來規模最大的一次動員；摩西·達揚主持國防部，戰後他承認情報系統已知埃及徵用民航機、徵集渡河器材等徵兆，卻未能判斷進攻時刻，即所謂了解一切而唯獨不知道正在發生什麼。大衛·埃拉扎爾任總參謀長，統籌兩線作戰並在十月中旬主持渡河反攻，戰後由哈伊姆·赫爾佐格接任；阿里埃勒·沙龍指揮西奈方向的裝甲集群，是最早主張深入縱深、渡河切斷埃及補給線的將領；阿夫拉罕·阿丹指揮第一四三裝甲師並一度接掌北部戰區，其後由伊扎克·拉賓接手；巴爾萊夫防線即以同名將領命名。埃及方面，薩達特把跨越運河的突擊交給裝甲部隊與工程兵分頭執行，前線由陸軍參謀部在西奈的指揮部負責。蘇聯事前向開闢方提供了進攻日期與部分編制情報，但情報未能及時傳到以色列一側；美國情報機關在開戰前亦有察覺，同樣未能即時送達決策層。
peopleEn: The decisive figures sat at the two ends of the conflict. Anwar Sadat was the author of the offensive: he chose the Day of Atonement for the opening shot and settled with Hafez al-Assad beforehand that the two fronts would strike together, so that Israel could not concentrate its troops and air power; al-Assad's task was to pin the Israeli reserves on the Golan front, and his command structure in turn failed to retake the key high ground. Golda Meir ran the mobilisation and authorised the call-up of the reserves, the largest mobilisation in the history of the state; Moshe Dayan headed the Ministry of Defence and afterwards admitted that the intelligence services had already known of Egyptian requisitions of civil aircraft and of the gathering of river-crossing equipment, yet could not judge the hour of the attack, knowing everything except what was happening. David Elazar was chief of staff, coordinating operations on both fronts and directing the counter-offensive across the canal in mid-October, and was succeeded after the war by Chaim Herzog; Ariel Sharon commanded the armoured group in the Sinai and was the officer who earliest argued for driving deep and crossing the canal to cut the Egyptian supply line; Avraham Adan commanded the 143rd Armoured Division and for a time took over the northern front, after which Yitzhak Rabin relieved him; the Bar Lev Line took its name from the general of the same name. On the Egyptian side Sadat entrusted the crossing itself to the armoured troops and the engineers working in parallel, with the front in Sinai run by the army staff command there. The Soviet Union passed the date of the attack and part of the order of battle to the attacking side beforehand, but the information did not reach Israel in time; American intelligence also detected what was coming before the war and likewise failed to deliver it to the decision makers.
kits: 本卡兵器是M60A1巴頓戰車，1971年以色列自美國接收並列裝，1973年配屬西奈與戈蘭方向的裝甲部隊，用於前線火力支援。它配備105毫米線膛炮，炮口初速與穿甲能力介於當代各型主戰坦克之間，但車體正面裝甲約五十毫米，屬單層薄裝甲，無核生化防護，車重大約十五噸，行進間射擊精度有限，極限涉水深度不足，維持成本與故障率都偏高。它最大的弱點在防禦與觀察：車體無乘員隔艙，尾部與側面在反坦克火箭筒面前幾乎無防護。數量上，以軍以M48A3改裝型「Magach」為主力，以色列全軍M60A1的總數只是數百輛級，遠少於Magach。以色列另有F-4鬼怪式與A-4天鷹式戰鬥機、幻影式，地面有M42自走高射砲、M113裝甲車、M109與M107自走榴彈砲、一百三十與一百五十五毫米牽引砲、加百列反坦克飛彈與各型迫擊砲。埃及與敘利亞使用蘇制T-34、T-54、T-55、T-62與少量T-72，配合BMP系列裝甲車、ZSU-23-4自走高射砲、BM-21多管火箭砲、一百三十與一百五十二毫米火炮，單兵反坦克主力是RPG-7與AT-3火箭筒；埃及另存有美製M46戰車。全役已無成建制騎兵作戰，機動全靠輪式車輛與空運。」
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the M60A1 Patton tank, taken by Israel from the United States and fielded in 1971; in 1973 it was assigned to the armoured formations facing Sinai and the Golan for fire support on the forward line. It carried a 105mm rifled gun whose muzzle velocity and penetration sat between those of the contemporary main battle tanks, but the hull carried only about fifty millimetres of frontal armour in a single-skin design, it had no nuclear, biological or chemical protection, its weight was roughly fifteen tonnes, its firing accuracy on the move was limited, its maximum fording depth was shallow, and its running costs and failure rates were high. Its greatest weakness lay in protection and observation: the hull offered no crew compartmentation, and the rear and flanks were almost unprotected against anti-tank rocket launchers. In numbers the backbone of the Israeli armoured force was the modified M48A3 known as the Magach; the total Israeli strength in the M60A1 was only in the hundreds, far below the number of Magachs. Israel also had F-4 Phantoms and A-4 Skyhawks with the Mirage, and on the ground the M42 self-propelled anti-aircraft gun, the M113 armoured personnel carrier, the M109 and M107 self-propelled howitzers, 130mm and 155mm towed guns, the Gabriel anti-tank missile and mortars of every type. Egypt and Syria fielded Soviet T-34, T-54, T-55, T-62 and a small number of T-72, supported by BMP series armoured vehicles, the ZSU-23-4 self-propelled anti-aircraft gun, the BM-21 multiple rocket launcher and 130mm and 152mm guns, while the principal infantry anti-tank weapons were the RPG-7 and the AT-3 rocket launcher; Egypt also still held American M46 tanks. No formed cavalry fought in the campaign at all: all movement rested on wheeled vehicles and airlift.
tactics: 埃及的攻勢代號巴德爾行動，準備工作以工程兵架設浮橋與徵用渡河器材為核心，選在下午兩時整齊射：炮火準備時間控制在一小時以內，隨即以二千門以上火炮壓制巴爾萊夫防線，突擊縱隊搭乘水陸兩棲車與裝甲車渡河，再由步兵以RPG-7護衛坦克衝破沙袋堡壘，向東展開至縱深二十公里左右建立橋頭堡。縱隊編制強調坦克、步兵與反坦克小組同行，但步坦協同與空地火力支援不足，使首批戰車大量暴露在反坦克武器之前。敘利亞在戈蘭以步兵師正面反斜面滲透，配合炮兵火力與反坦克火箭筒消耗以色列前沿，卻因缺乏迂迴與縱深突破手段而停在陣地前。以軍應戰初期被動，後轉為縱深反擊：沙龍集中裝甲部隊實施突擊作戰，北方由烏茲·達揚指揮的部隊奪取山區隘口，十月十五日夜以代號「格利夫特」的渡河行動，由第一六二師等部渡過蘇伊士運河，在大苦湖一帶建立灘頭，插入埃及縱深並威脅其通往阿里什的補給線；同時以「哈姆尼拔」與「魔毯」空運補給團與後備兵，恢復連續作戰能力。全役顯示以軍作戰術的重大缺陷：炮兵觀察與空中火力觀察分離，火力調度遲緩；此役後以軍把炮兵觀察制度化，裝甲部隊也改採分隊、間距與交替掩護的運用方式。
tacticsEn: The Egyptian offensive was code-named Operation Badr, and its preparation turned on the engineers bridging the canal and on the requisition of crossing equipment; the barrage was timed for two in the afternoon, with the preparatory shelling kept under an hour, after which more than two thousand guns pounded the Bar Lev Line. The assault columns crossed on amphibious vehicles and armoured vehicles, infantry with RPG-7s shielding the tanks as they broke through the sandbagged positions and drove eastward to establish a bridgehead roughly twenty kilometres deep. The columns were organised so that tanks, infantry and anti-tank teams moved together, but the infantry-tank coordination and the air-ground fire support were inadequate, and the leading tanks were left exposed in front of anti-tank weapons. In the Golan Syria used its infantry divisions to infiltrate forward from the reverse slopes, wearing down the Israeli forward line with artillery and anti-tank rockets, but the offensive stalled short of its objectives for want of turning movements and depth. Israel was on the defensive at first and then shifted to the counter-offensive: Sharon concentrated the armour for a breakthrough, in the north the troops under Uzi Dayan seized the mountain passes, and on the night of the fifteenth of October an operation code-named Grift took the 162nd Division and other formations across the Suez Canal, establishing a beachhead around the Great Bitter Lake, driving a wedge into the Egyptian rear and threatening the supply route to El Arish. At the same time the Hannibal and Magic Carpet airlift missions brought in supply columns and reserve troops, restoring the ability to fight continuously. The campaign exposed grave defects in Israeli tactics: artillery observation was separated from air fire support, so the adjustment of fire was slow; afterwards the army institutionalised artillery observation, and the armoured formations changed to a style of smaller elements, greater spacing and alternate covering.
data: 可核對的時間與數字大致如下。開戰日為1973年10月6日，適逢猶太曆贖罪日、伊斯蘭曆齋月第十日；埃及與以色列的停火協議於10月22日簽訂，戈蘭前線的脫離接觸協議延至1974年5月才達成，主要戰鬥集中在十月六日至十月二十日之間。兵員方面，埃及在蘇伊士方向投入兵力屬十萬級別，火炮二千門以上，突擊正面約一百六十公里的運河線；敘利亞在戈蘭正面投入數個步兵師與一個裝甲師，陣線約七十公里；以色列動員後備軍二十餘萬，全軍作戰兵力逾五十萬，火炮逾一千門，坦克總數約一千七百至兩千輛。損失方面，以色列陣亡約二千六百至二千八百人、受傷約七千人，損失戰車約一千輛，其中Magach型佔大多數，損失飛機約一百架；埃及陣亡與受傷合計上萬人，損失戰車約二千輛、首日最為慘重，損失飛機約二百五十至三百架；敘利亞陣亡約三千五百人，損失戰車約六百輛，損失飛機約一百架。補給方面，美方以「魔毯」空運在數週內運入近萬噸軍火，並以「兄弟」空運投入數千名後備兵員，以色列在戰後數月內另獲美方補充數百輛坦克。載卡兵器M60A1的公開諸元為105毫米線膛炮、有效射程約一千五百米、車重約十五噸、單層裝甲設計。各家戰史對損失數字分歧頗大，上列以主流估計為準。
dataEn: The verifiable dates and figures are broadly as follows. The war opened on 6 October 1973, coinciding with the Jewish Day of Atonement and the tenth of the Islamic month of Ramadan; the ceasefire agreement between Egypt and Israel was signed on 22 October, while the disengagement agreement on the Golan was not reached until May 1974, and the main fighting lay between 6 and 20 October. On troops: Egypt committed forces on the Suez axis in the order of a hundred thousand, more than two thousand guns, and an assault front of roughly one hundred and sixty kilometres of canal; Syria committed several infantry divisions and one armoured division on the Golan front over about seventy kilometres; Israel mobilised more than two hundred thousand reservists, fielded over half a million troops, more than a thousand guns and roughly seventeen to twenty hundred tanks in total. On losses: Israel lost about two thousand six hundred to two thousand eight hundred dead and some seven thousand wounded, about a thousand tanks, most of them Magachs, and about a hundred aircraft; Egypt lost upwards of ten thousand dead and wounded, about two thousand tanks, with the heaviest losses on the first day, and about two hundred and fifty to three hundred aircraft; Syria lost about three thousand five hundred dead, around six hundred tanks and roughly a hundred aircraft. On supply: the American Magic Carpet airlift brought in close to ten thousand tonnes of materiel within weeks, and the Brothers operation airlifted several thousand reservists; Israel received several hundred further tanks from the United States in the months after the war. The published specifications of the M60A1 on this card are a 105mm rifled gun, an effective range of about one thousand five hundred metres, a weight of about fifteen tonnes and a single-skin armour design. The sources differ markedly over the loss figures, and the above follow the mainstream estimates.
cause: 開戰的起因要從1967年六日戰爭說起。以色列在那一役佔領西奈半島、戈蘭高地、約旦河西岸與加沙等大片土地，阿拉伯國家在軍事與外交上全面受挫；翌年阿拉伯國家的石油儲量雖集中於波斯灣與沙特的油田，卻無從轉化為籌碼，埃及的軍隊被限制在尼羅河東岸，蘇伊士運河在以軍控制下不能通航，經濟與軍力都難以恢復。進入1970年代，美國在中東的政策轉向以土地換和平為口號推動聯合國第242號決議框架下的談判，1970年的羅傑斯方案無法取得進展，埃及卻被要求先行讓步，1973年初的華盛頓會談亦告破裂，薩達特面對的現實是談判不會有成果而軍力差距仍在擴大。與此同時，埃及在1972年重整軍備，驅逐蘇聯軍事顧問並請回被解僱的美國專家，改向法國、意大利與南斯拉夫等國採購技術與裝備，修建橫跨運河的浮橋並重建砲兵體系；敘利亞亦整軍，兩國在蘇聯情報機構協助下商定同一日進攻的協同計畫。埃及選擇贖罪日為開戰日，因為當日以軍戒備最低、後備軍尚未召集，而下午兩時開火可使以軍援軍在數小時內無法到達。開戰能達成完全奇襲，與以軍情報系統的失誤直接相關：摩薩德已掌握部分徵兵與徵用民航機的徵兆，卻未能判斷進攻時刻。
causeEn: The origins of the war have to be traced back to the Six-Day War of 1967. In that campaign Israel took the Sinai Peninsula, the Golan Heights, the West Bank of the Jordan and Gaza, and the Arab states were checked militarily and diplomatically on every front. The following year the Arab share of world oil reserves, though concentrated in the Persian Gulf and the Saudi fields, could not be converted into leverage; the Egyptian army was confined to the east bank of the Nile, the Suez Canal could not be navigated under Israeli control, and neither the economy nor the armed forces could recover. During the 1970s American policy in the Middle East turned to promoting negotiations inside the framework of United Nations Resolution 242 under the slogan of land for peace; the Rogers Plan of 1970 made no progress, Egypt was required to give way first, and the Washington talks at the beginning of 1973 broke down, so that Sadat faced a situation in which negotiation would yield nothing while the gap in military strength kept widening. Meanwhile Egypt reorganised its armed forces in 1972, expelled Soviet military advisers and recalled the American specialists who had been dismissed, turned to France, Italy and Yugoslavia for technology and equipment, built pontoon bridges across the canal and rebuilt the artillery system; Syria likewise reorganised, and the two countries agreed a plan for a simultaneous offensive with Soviet intelligence assistance. Egypt chose the Day of Atonement because Israeli readiness was at its lowest and the reserves had not been called out, and because a barrage at two in the afternoon left the Israeli reinforcements unable to arrive within a few hours. That the opening was a complete surprise was due directly to the failure of the Israeli intelligence system: the Mossad had already picked up signs of mobilisation and the requisition of civil aircraft, yet could not determine the hour of the attack.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果延伸到1970年代之後。就以色列而言，這是1967年以來第一次付出重大代價的戰爭，傷亡數字與戰車損失比例在以色列軍事史上都是空前的，輿論對國防部的批評迫使摩西·達揚在阿格拉納特委員會的調查之後下台，果爾達·梅里爾也在1974年大選中落敗；軍隊的教訓直接催生了編制與準則的改變：步兵與裝甲合成的強制訓練、炮兵觀察制度、縱深反擊的作戰理論，以及1970年代後期問世的梅卡瓦主戰坦克。就阿拉伯方面而言，埃及雖未取得地面戰果，卻首次以自身掌握的攻勢主動權換取了談判地位，1978年戴維營協議之後，1979年以色列開始從西奈撤退，1982年完成交還。戈蘭方面，1974年5月的脫離接觸協議把主權歸還敘利亞，聯合國脫離接觸觀察員部隊進駐該區。以色列在戰後與美國簽訂軍事援助備忘錄，冷戰後期中東的物資流向因此徹底改變。經濟方面，戰爭直接引發1973年石油危機，阿拉伯產油國以禁運和減產對付支持以色列的國家，油價在短時間內上漲數倍，衝擊全球工業與運輸，也改變了能源結構與國力分佈。區域政治上，埃及與敘利亞因戰後路線分歧而交惡，阿拉伯聯盟內部出現以埃及為首與反埃及的分野。中國方面，官方媒體的大量報導把此役敘述為阿拉伯國家反抗美國支持以色列的戰爭，中國向埃及提供軍事與技術援助，但在埃及於1979年與美國簽署條約之後，中埃關係轉冷。
impactEn: The consequences of this war ran well into the years after the 1970s. For Israel it was the first war since 1967 to cost dearly, and the casualty figures and the proportion of tanks lost were without precedent in the military history of the state; public criticism of the Ministry of Defence forced Moshe Dayan to step down after the Agranat Commission inquiry, and Golda Meir was defeated in the 1974 elections. The lessons of the army drove organisational and doctrinal change: compulsory infantry-armour combined training, an artillery observation system, a theory of the counter-offensive into depth, and in the late 1970s the appearance of the Merkava main battle tank. For the Arab side, although Egypt gained no ground on the battlefield, it converted the initiative of an offensive it had planned itself into a bargaining position at the talks; after the Camp David agreements of 1978 Israel began withdrawing from Sinai in 1979 and completed the handover in 1982. In the Golan, the disengagement agreement of May 1974 restored sovereignty to Syria and the United Nations Disengagement Observer Force was deployed there. After the war Israel signed a military aid memorandum with the United States, and the flow of materiel in the late Cold War Middle East was transformed. Economically, the war triggered the 1973 oil crisis: the Arab producers answered Israel's supporters with embargo and production cuts, oil prices rose severalfold in a short time, the shock ran through industry and transport worldwide, and the structure of energy supply and the balance of power between states were altered. In regional politics Egypt and Syria fell out over the line each took after the war, and the Arab League split between an Egyptian-led camp and an anti-Egyptian one. As for China, the extensive coverage in the official press presented the campaign as a war of the Arab states against American support for Israel, and China supplied Egypt with military and technical assistance; but after Egypt signed a treaty with the United States in 1979, Chinese-Egyptian relations turned cold.
result: 結局是雙方都沒有得到想要的東西。埃及在運河東岸保留了一個縱深數十公里的橋頭堡，卻因渡河初期損失慘重而無法擴張戰果；以色列在西奈失守初期陣地後收復了巴爾萊夫防線全線，又以十月十五日夜的渡河行動在大苦湖一帶插下灘頭，切斷埃及縱深並威脅其主要補給線，這支插入的兵力最終成為1974年談判中以色列的籌碼。以軍在戈蘭擊退敘利亞的正面攻勢，佔領部分陣地，但敘軍仍控制加利利角與班塔基山一線，僵局一直延續到1974年。10月22日簽訂的埃及與以色列停火協議由聯合國中東特別部隊監督，戈蘭的脫離接觸協議於1974年5月簽訂，雙方在聯合國觀察下分隔。從結果看，這場戰爭改變了中東的權力語言：以色列證明自己守得住，卻付出遠超預期的代價；阿拉伯國家第一次在協同行動中打出有聲有色的攻勢，卻在攻勢之後發現彼此更難共享成果。戰役結束時仍有大量被擄人員與裝備待處理，戰線的最終走向要等到1974至1982年間的多次局部戰鬥才逐一確定，而蘇伊士運河則在1980年代之後重新成為國際航運的樞紐。
resultEn: The end left neither side with what it wanted. Egypt kept a bridgehead several tens of kilometres deep on the east bank of the canal, but the heavy losses of the opening crossing prevented it from enlarging the prize; Israel, having lost its forward positions in Sinai at first, recovered the whole Bar Lev Line, and the crossing on the night of the fifteenth of October planted a beachhead around the Great Bitter Lake, cutting the Egyptian rear and threatening the main supply line, and the force thus inserted became the Israeli bargaining chip in the 1974 talks. In the Golan the Israeli army broke the frontal Syrian offensive and held some positions, but the Syrian army retained the line of the Horns of Hattin and the Bentaki mountain, and the deadlock lasted on into 1974. The ceasefire agreement between Egypt and Israel signed on 22 October was supervised by the United Nations Truce Supervision Organization, and the disengagement agreement on the Golan was signed in May 1974, the two sides separated under United Nations observation. Judged by the result, the war changed the language of power in the Middle East: Israel proved that it could hold, but at a cost far beyond what had been expected; the Arab states mounted for the first time a co-ordinated offensive that was both conspicuous and forceful, only to find afterwards that they could share the results of an offensive even less easily than before. Large numbers of prisoners and items of equipment were still awaiting sorting out when the campaign ended, the final alignment of the front was settled only piecemeal through the local wars of 1974 to 1982, and the Suez Canal itself was to become once again the pivot of international navigation in the 1980s.
